description: Curated HMS user questions and independently worded source passages. Queries are not stored as documents. Embedding fields may be added by scripts/evaluate-local-model.mjs.

documents.text: Keep backups of the memory store on a separate disk. Verify each backup before using it to restore lost records.
Encryption protects stored documents against unauthorized disk access. Supply the encryption passphrase through an environment variable.
Metadata filtering limits retrieval to documents in a selected project. A filter checks document attributes before choosing the best matches.
Divide long documents into overlapping chunks. Each passage retains its source URI and byte offsets so an answer can cite the relevant section.
Index maintenance trains a search index using a consistent snapshot. Schedule maintenance outside the ingestion path to avoid slow writes.
Re-encode original source documents when changing the embedding model. Create a separate destination store and keep the existing data until verification finishes.
Structured facts contain a subject, a relation, and an object. Two linked father relations allow a multi-hop query to find a grandfather.
Local models run on your own computer. Loading model files from disk permits semantic retrieval without sending documents to a remote service.
A reranker compares each candidate passage with the question. It reorders the retrieved candidates using a more expensive relevance model.
Deleting a document removes all of its chunks. The deletion is recorded durably so removed content stays absent after restarting the application.
Batch ingestion groups several records into one transaction. All records are validated before committing, and the batch has a fixed size limit.
Differential privacy adds calibrated random noise to a clipped histogram. Repeated releases consume a cumulative privacy budget.
